subject: Shinyapps.io > Account > Settings > Transfer Account Not Working

messages.author: 47e7aa9b192efc0d
messages.subject: Shinyapps.io > Account > Settings > Transfer Account Not Working
parts:
Hi,

We have a free version of shinyapps.io at the moment.
The account is accessible using my Google Account...I am the developer.

We want to upgrade the account.
To do that, I want to transfer the account to the owner of the application.

The 'Transfer Account' does not allow me to enter in another email address and then click 'Save'.
Doing some testing on my Mac and the latest Chrome...I was able to enter in my own [account].me.com.
The *.me.com was the only one that seemed to work.

Please reach out when you get an opportunity.

All the best,

John
